The central figure is a male musician with long blonde hair playing an electric violin, wearing a black t-shirt and shorts. To his left is another musician in a hat playing guitar/bass, and to the right, a keyboardist. The background consists of large black speaker stacks and trussing structures typical of a festival or large venue setup.
